title: UI layer reaches past the service layer into the database
summary: A three-layer app (ui -> service -> db) has a UI component importing the db layer directly, bypassing the service boundary. It compiles and works, so only an architecture gate catches the eroded boundary.
plantedDescription: user-card.ts (ui layer) imports directly from ../db/user-repository, which the layer model forbids — ui may depend on service only.
expectedFix: Route the read through the service layer: user-card.ts imports from ../service/user-service, and the service calls the repository. The ui->db import is removed so the layer model holds.

rubric.detected: Agent identifies the ui->db import as an architectural layer violation (not just a refactor preference).
rubric.correctCheck: Agent runs or cites `harness check-arch` as the gate that catches the boundary crossing.
rubric.fixed: The ui module no longer imports the db layer; the call goes through the service layer.
rubric.noCollateral: The service and db layers still work and the rendered output is unchanged.
